Normalise publisher names

Source: R/normalize.R
normalize_publisher.Rd

Replaces & with and, squishes whitespace and applies a lookup of known variants, so that journals and agreements use one name per publisher.

Usage

normalize_publisher(x, lookup = NULL)

Arguments

x

Character vector of publisher names.

lookup

Data frame with columns name (variant) and publisher (normalised name). Lookups are matched after & has been replaced.

Value

Character vector.

Examples

normalize_publisher(c("Taylor & Francis", "CSIRO"),
  lookup = data.frame(name = "CSIRO", publisher = "CSIRO Publishing"))
#> [1] "Taylor and Francis" "CSIRO Publishing"
